target: standalone bibliography-like regions rather than isolated citation-looking lines

iteration_history.observed_collision: 971 silver-BIB lines in one document were placed under the exact heading ΣΥΝΤΟΜΟΓΡΑΦΙΕΣ
iteration_history.principled_correction: abbreviations headings remain structural line roles but cannot establish a hard negative section scope

retain: mixed narrative endnotes and explanatory footnotes
research-summary tables whose rows describe studies rather than list references
removal_policy.headers: attach exact bibliography headers only after a bibliography-like block exists

model_inputs: eight mutually exclusive deterministic competing roles

hard_scope_rule.reason: an abbreviations section can expand citation keys into complete bibliography entries

precision_first_plain.train_oof_selection: unchanged from v1: highest recall plain contextual threshold with raw-silver line precision at least 0.95

recall_first_plain.train_oof_selection: unchanged from v1: highest-recall threshold in the predeclared plain contextual grid

recall_first_anchored.selection: highest corrected train-OOF line recall with raw-silver line precision at least 0.90 from the same registered low-anchor grid
recall_first_anchored.purpose: retain high recall while forbidding isolated line deletion

validation_selection_rule: report every frozen candidate; validation may diagnose failures but may not select an unregistered threshold
label_caveat: LLM-silver misses real bibliography blocks; preserve raw-silver metrics and separately adjudicate reviewed blocks without silently rewriting historical labels
